notes: Every flashcard now shows a sentence. The first 303 words of the Croatian deck, the whole A0 core you meet in your first weeks, had a word and a translation and nothing else: no example under the word, nothing for the app to read aloud, and no fill-in-the-blank drill, because that drill is built from the example. All 303 are written, checked against every sentence the course already teaches so none of them is a repeat. Two cards that showed the same Croatian word are now told apart, and four drills that could blank the wrong word in their own sentence are fixed.
